units: <cite ref="Beitzah 2b:12">Bets. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>משום ה׳</he> on account of the law requiring readiness for use on the preceding day.
<cite ref="Beitzah 4a:14">Ib. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ דרבה</he> the law about readiness as interpreted by Rabbah (<cite ref="Beitzah 2b:8">ib. 2ᵇ</cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (ref. to תכין Deut. XIX, 3) marking out the road to the city of refuge for the involuntary manslayer.
